title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
abstract: arXiv:2610.41479v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. translated_title: EvoMCP：MCP智能体与训练数据的协同进化
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议（MCP）智能体的监督微调通常在静态数据分布上进行，这无法适应学生模型不断发展的能力，也未能充分解决新暴露出来的弱点。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EvoMCP，这是一个智能体与数据相互进化的框架，使MCP智能体能够通过任务进化、轨迹演化和监督微调构成的闭环来持续改进。具体而言，EvoMCP从rollout反馈中评估学生模型已具备的能力与能力差距，以确定学习目标。随后，任务进化通过调整相兼容的已验证种子任务的指令和可观察环境状态，同时保持其验证器的一致性，将这些学习目标转化为可执行的任务。为了给这些任务提供可靠且高效的示范，轨迹进化利用可复用的技能来恢复失败的教师rollout……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EvoMCP框架，通过任务进化、轨迹演化和监督微调构成的闭环，实现MCP智能体与训练数据的协同进化，动态弥补学生模型不断变化的能力差距。
